data.title: Thai ghost mystery Delusion released next month on Netflix
data.description: <p>Netflix last week released the first images of Delusion, a new intense mystery series that unravels the relationships within a family through a complex investigation that is scheduled for global release on Sept 24.</p>

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Aug 18
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Juli Baker and Summer reflects on generational love and devotion
data.description: <p>The memories between a grandmother and a grandchild are portrayed during "Flying Is Not Scary", which is running at RCB Galleria 5, 3rd floor of River City Bangkok, until Sept 20.</p>

data.title: Exercise remains crucial part of bone health
data.description: <p>Dear Doctors: What is the best or most effective way to treat osteoporosis and osteopenia? I have tried several medications. One had too many side effects, so I had to stop. I took another one for two years, but you have to keep taking it and I prefer not to.</p>

data.title: Volunteer clinic treats over  1,000 people in Ayutthaya
data.description: <p>A volunteer medical unit provided free healthcare to 1,037 people in Ayutthaya on Sunday, more than double its initial target of 500.</p>

data.title: Explore the journey of stories at  'Mooring' in Bangkok Kunsthalle
data.description: <p>Ponder how history, memory or belief can shift through storytelling, listening and reinterpretation during "Mooring", which is running at Bangkok Kunsthalle until Sept 29.</p>

data.title: Govt to replace Andaman tsunami buoy 'in November'
data.description: <p>A tsunami-monitoring buoy off the Andaman coast will be replaced in November after it stopped transmitting data, with officials blaming possible damage from strong southwest monsoon waves.</p>

data.title: South bridge deals to be inked Aug 31
data.description: <p>Contracts for two major bridge projects in the South are expected to be signed on Aug 31, with construction scheduled to begin this year and both bridges due to open in August 2029.</p>

data.title: 53 firms probed in nominee crackdown
data.description: <p>Fifty-three companies in Sakon Nakhon are being investigated for allegedly using Thai nominees to conceal Chinese ownership, Deputy Interior Minister Polapee Suwunchwee said yesterday.</p>

data.title: Three cuffed over ties to fake tax invoices network
data.description: <p>Three people have been arrested for allegedly selling fake tax invoices to businesses seeking to reduce their tax bills, with investigators saying the network had operated for about five years.</p>

data.title: Udon Thani to be medical tech hub
data.description: <p>The government is moving to establish Udon Thani as an "Innovation Sandbox" for Thai medical technology, initially introducing four products from the Thai Innovation Account into the national healthcare system under the universal 30-baht scheme.</p>

data.title: Leading ladies
data.description: <p>In Joey Wu's Bird Of Paradise (2026), Yeung, a middle-aged, worn-out housewife, spends her days cooking, cleaning and caring for her household with little time for herself. Where Henrik Ibsen's Nora in A Doll's House (1879) leaves her family to find freedom, Yeung's act of defiance is signing up for a pole dancing class.</p>

data.title: Kingdom's wakeboarders ride into world's top three
data.description: <p>Thailand's cable wakeboard and wakeskate squad have emerged as Asia's leading force and secured a coveted place among the world's elite, finishing third overall at the IWWF World Cable Wakeboard &amp; Wakeskate Championships 2026 in Beijing.</p>

data.title: Supanida fights back in tight duel
data.description: <p>Supanida Katethong edged compatriot Busanan Ongbamrungphan in the first round of the BWF World Championships 2026 in New Delhi yesterday.</p>

data.title: Lives at risk in war on pollution
data.description: <p>For years, residents of Prachin Buri have fought industrial waste pollution that they say has contaminated farmland and waterways. But for some leading the fight, protecting their communities has come at a far higher price: threats to their lives.</p>

data.title: Anutin sets limits for censure debate
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said his ministers were ready for a no-confidence debate but would not answer for Senate election allegations he called unrelated to the government.</p>

data.title: Colombian minister under fire over beach holiday post-quake
data.description: BOGOTá - Colombia's new housing minister has come under fire after it emerged that he took his family on a Caribbean holiday while the country was reeling from a devastating earthquake that left thousands homeless.

data.title: PM to boost relations with Australia, NZ
data.description: <p>Thailand will seek to expand trade, investment, technology and creative-economy cooperation with Australia and New Zealand during Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul's visits to the two countries.</p>

data.title: NOCT targets 14-15 golds at Aichi-Nagoya
data.description: <p>The National Olympic Committee of Thailand (NOCT) has set a target of 14-15 gold medals at the Asian Games, which will take place in Aichi-Nagoya from Sept 19 to Oct 4.</p>

data.title: Thailand vow no complacency
data.description: <p>Despite holding a 3‑1 advantage from the first leg, Thailand will march into&nbsp; Tuesday night's semi‑final second leg against Singapore determined to treat the contest as if the scoreline were still level.</p>

data.title: Probe into civil exam fraud widens
data.description: <p>Police have charged senior officials over alleged fraud in local government recruitment examinations and are expanding the investigation to include brokers and others suspected of involvement in the scheme.</p>
